site: rx_search: entry rx_reqrun (memchr 'a' + "at " check) -> unanchored forward DFA -> reverse DFA pass (artifact.c:63-75, 83-626)
observation: The cell's median is set by the 4 `fail` subjects, whose whole cost is rx_reqrun walking memchr('a') over the subject: 33,377 memchr calls per MiB (one per 'a', ~31 B each) to prove "at " absent. The pattern also requires '(' and ')', each ~8.7x rarer than 'a' (3,819/MiB). On `hit` the per-match work is 67 forward + 67 reverse DFA steps on top of ~33k memchr('a').
proposed_change: Anchor the scan on the rarer required byte '(': memchr('('), walk back over the [A-Za-z0-9_$.] run before it, require "at " immediately before the run, then run the artifact's own anchored DFA (rx_match) at that start; on failure continue after the '('. Drops rx_reqrun, the unanchored forward DFA and the reverse pass from rx_search.
regime: fail + hit (the cell median is the fail group); syslog unchanged (dismissed by the existing memchr(')'))
correctness_argument: Every match is "at " R "(" ... with R in [A-Za-z0-9_$.]* and '(' not in that set, so each match start p has exactly one '(' q (the first after p) and the backward run from q recovers p uniquely (p+2 is a space, outside the set). Candidates are monotone in q, so the first q whose candidate passes the anchored automaton gives the leftmost start; the anchored entry is the artifact's own PCRE-equivalent answer at a fixed start and the end is unique per start (the identifier run cannot hold '(' and every paren body ends at its first ')'). \b is checked by rx_match's seed. Linear: backward runs are disjoint (bounded by the previous '('), an anchored run dies by the next '('. Identity PASS plain + ASan/UBSan; controls ctldollar ('$' dropped from the run set) and ctlfrom (start == search_from refused) both FAIL.
expected_effect: Counts per MiB, fail: memchr calls 33,377 -> 3,820 (+6,932 table-test back steps); hit: 33,155 memchr('a') + 659 memchr('t') + 44,359 fwd + 44,359 rev DFA steps -> 3,633 memchr('(') + 31,103 back steps + 44,359 anchored DFA steps. Expect the largest win of the set on fail and hit (several-fold on fail by call count). scratch timing owed.
generality_guess: Any pattern = required literal prefix + a bounded class run + a rarer required byte outside that run (identifier/call/log shapes); the general form is 'scan the rarest required byte, recover the start by a backward class run'. Needs a census.
